name: omnibridge/static
description: The static host of the omnibridge family: a generic exporter that enumerates an application's addresses (explicit lists, a router's #[Route] routes with the values of their parameters, a sitemap), renders each at build time by the application's own code (its host's request handling, its actions, or any callable), and writes a deterministic folder for a static host or a CDN - HTML pages, the files of an asset manifest (Vite, Webpack), the files the pages refer to, redirections, 404.html, sitemap.xml and a report with checksums and diagnostics (broken links, duplicate outputs, missing assets, non-deterministic pages). No framework, no bundler.

suggest.symfony/routing: Route\RouteCollectionProvider: the pages of a router's routes (Symfony's router, omnibridge/laravel's Routing\ActionRoutes, symfony/routing's attribute loader)
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: Render\RequestRenderer: pages rendered through a host's own request handling (Symfony's kernel, Laravel's)
suggest.psr/container: Render\ActionRenderer: pages rendered by calling the route's action, taken from a PSR-11 container
